material_definitions: The study focuses on LISICON materials series Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1).
Li3P(1-x)VxO4 and Li4GeO4 are LISICONs without partial lithium occupancy.
Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4 and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8) are compounds with partial lithium occupancy.
Aliovalent substitution of P5+ or V5+ for Ge4+ creates partial lithium occupancy and leads to higher conductivities.
warnings: Raw conductivity value was extracted from approximate value (~2x10^-10)
